findings.summary: The nudge delivers an app-mediated message to another account, but no send operation exists and no revocation or authorization policy governs the affordance or MessageDraft, so the required current-state block/disconnect check on send has no home in the spec.
findings.evidence: Nudge effects: 'Delivers a short "thinking of you" card ... inside the app'; links only '{ rel: writes, to: entity.MessageDraft }'. policy.revocation: 'Read and send authorization must check revocation against current authoritative state'. MessageDraft gets only a storedIn link, while every other stored entity has a 'governs' link from a policy.

findings.summary: Nothing on the recipient side models how a nudge is received or displayed, so 'delivers ... inside the app' points to a missing piece.
findings.evidence: Nudge effect: 'Delivers a short "thinking of you" card from the owner to the connected person inside the app'. No screen or component in screen.today, screen.person or elsewhere reads entity.MessageDraft.

findings.summary: The new nodes are wired in incompletely.
findings.evidence: evolution.7 affectedNodes lists only the affordance and MessageDraft, yet the diff also changes screen.person and component.PersonActionBar. C.webapp.nudge.single has no sourceRefs, unlike sibling criteria such as 'sourceRefs: [S.webapp.operations]'. binding.contactsStore covers 'accounts, owned contacts, goals, events, consent and jobs', which does not include messages.
